optimizedDescription.value: Vendor-neutral Agent Skills standard adapter: render and install specd skills through @specd/skills.

optimizedContext.value:
# Plugin Agent Standard
## Rules
- Export named `create(options: PluginLoaderOptions): AgentPlugin`; read `name`/`version` from own `specd-plugin.json`, parent fallback; hardcode `type` as `'agent'`.
- Domain: runtime `AgentPlugin` class receives `name`, `version`; `type` getter `'agent'`; standard frontmatter type; per-skill map keyed name.
- Frontmatter allow only: required `name`, `description`; optional `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata: Record<string, string>`, `allowed-tools` (space-separated). Exclude unknown fields.
- `InstallSkills`: get via `@specd/skills`; resolve standard frontmatter; capability literal `['frontmatter']`; resolve through `ResolveBundle`; pass `variables.sharedFolder` only override default. Never prepend YAML, call `SkillRepository.getBundle(...)`, or use `buildCapabilities`.
- Non-shared: skills `.agents/skills/<skill-name>/`; agents alongside shared context (no `agents` capability). Shared: rendered `sharedFolder` under `projectRoot`; no `SKILL.md` in resolved shared location.
- Pass structured frontmatter to `@specd/skills`; output only configured supported fields. Shared files no frontmatter.
- `install()`: inject base prompt to `<projectRoot>/AGENTS.md` via `injectSpecdBlock(agentsMdPath, prompt)`; purge legacy with `removeSpecdBlock(agentsMdPath, "standard")`; inject no `<!-- <specd-plugin:standard> -->`. `uninstall()`: same legacy removal then `removeSpecdBlock(agentsMdPath)`.
- Per-skill `allowed-tools`: needed Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob; `Bash(node *)`, `Bash(specd *)`, `Bash(pnpm *)`; `Agent` where applicable.
- `specd project init` includes `@specd/plugin-agent-standard`; `@specd/specd` depends on it.
- Uninstall selected managed skill dirs only if `options.skills`; retain shared. No filter: remove all managed dirs and resolved shared. Never remove unrelated `.agents/skills/` content.
- Default standard installation includes `specd-fasttrack`: `ResolveBundle`, `frontmatter`, structured values, output `.agents/skills/specd-fasttrack/`; `allowed-tools` supports file ops/SpecD/Node/PNPM/delegation where supported; omit unsupported capability instructions.
## Constraints
- Depend on `@specd/skills`; implement `AgentPlugin` from `@specd/plugin-manager`; stay orchestration-only adapter.
- Factory reads manifest name/version and passes constructor; never hardcode. `type` always `'agent'`.
- Tool field is `allowed-tools`, never `allowed_tools`.
